content: Human-labeling session — econ-second-base-race:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a second-base race. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), a Power Plant (powr) and one idle harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) in the NORTH-WEST corner of a 112x40 arena, with $2000 in the bank. A small ore patch sits next to your base; a RICH CONTESTED patch sits far to the SOUTH-EAST at (88, 30). Within about 40 turns, own an Ore Refinery inside the target disk (radius 6 around (88, 30)) and reach economy value $3500 — a tighter cash bar than the lower tier.
